permissions.//deny: No Read() deny rules on purpose (2026-09-03): with ANY Read() deny configured, Claude Code 2.1.259 forces a user prompt for every compound `cd X && grep|cat|head|sed <relative path>` because it cannot resolve the file statically — in every mode, bypass included. The .env guard it bought was weak anyway (only recognized readers, cwd-anchored, subprocesses unaffected). Want it back: sandbox.filesystem.denyRead, validated separately.
permissions.//defaultMode: bypassPermissions for bare `claude` launches (ae aliases pass --permission-mode bypassPermissions, which wins). auto was the 2026-08-14 rollout default; the classifier only adds friction in this trusted-local workflow.

//autoCompactWindow: 400000 (was 500000, 2026-09-11): the effective context window auto-compaction is measured against; it can only lower the model's real window, never raise it. Installed CC 2.1.268 fires at that window minus a ~13k reserve (~387k here), earlier still when the precompute buffer applies. Smaller steady-state working set means less cached context re-sent per turn — a deliberate cost/quota trade-off, not a guaranteed saving, since more compactions also means more summaries. Roll back to 500000 if continuity regresses. CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW overrides this key; CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE (1-100) is supported but deliberately unset so one knob controls the threshold. Compaction fidelity is tuned in shared/AGENTS.md (`## Responses and compact instructions`), rendered into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.
//hooks: MessageDisplay prepends [HH:MM] to each assistant message — display-only (screen), zero tokens, transcript untouched.
//switchModelsOnFlag: false = do NOT auto-switch on a flagged request. Pause with choice (switch, or edit+retry) instead of silent switch. Same as /config -> Model & output -> 'Switch models when a message is flagged' off. (Fable-5.1-era routing was biology -> Opus 5, cyber -> Opus 4.8; Opus-5.5-era targets unverified 2026-09-22).
//model: opus[1m] = alias `opus` -> latest Opus = Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) since CC 2.1.280 (was Opus 5); pin the full ID if determinism matters. 1M native, 128K max output — `[1m]` redundant but documented; CLI wrote this form on /model opus (observed 2026-09-22). $4/$20 (cache read $0.20). Default Opus model on current CC — explicit choice of the tier. Fable 5.1 (credit-billed $10/$50) via `/model fable` when max capability matters. Requires CC >= 2.1.280. Verified 2026-09-22 (Anthropic Opus 5.5 overview + CC CHANGELOG).
//effort: `high` = unchanged interactive policy (Opus 5.5 vendor default is medium; Tier A: 'The default effort is `medium`... Set `effort` explicitly and re-run your sweep', 'Start at medium, the default' — no coding-specific level prescribed, so high stands; note 5.5 thinks more per turn than 5 at the same setting). Escalate per task: `/effort xhigh`, `claude --effort xhigh`, `ultrathink`; `max` is session-only unless `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`. Per-model override: `modelSettings.<id>.effortLevel`. fastMode deliberately UNSET: 5.5 fast mode is a Claude-API-only research preview (`speed: "fast"`, `fast-mode-2026-02-01`); CC `/fast` behavior on a 5.5 session unverified 2026-09-22. `alwaysThinkingEnabled` inert here (thinking always on, non-disablable on Opus 5.5) — kept for Opus 4.8 fallback sessions.
